features.name: Ram
features.desc: When you move 10 feet or more straight toward a creature and hit it with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use both the Damage and Shove options. You can only use this benefit once per turn.

features.name: Stable Stance
features.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid the Prone condition.

features.name: Protected by Nature

features.name: Friend of Fauna

features.name: Chilled Anatomy
features.desc: You have Resistance to Cold damage. You also know the Ray of Frost cantrip.

features.name: Compacted Snow
features.desc: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space. Additionally, you can squeeze through a space that is large enough for a creature one size smaller than you without movement penalties.

features.name: Frigid Construct
features.desc: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours unmoving; during this time you are indistinguishable from a snowman, but retain consciousness. You don't need to eat, drink or breathe.

features.name: Glacial Form
features.desc: Once per long rest, you can cast the False Life spell without using the material components or expending a spell slot, and harden your body into ice.

features.name: Guiding Light
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you can produce dim light in a 20 ft radius from your nose. You can end this effect as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Antler Defence
features.desc: Once per Short Rest as a Reaction, you can lower your antlers and enter a defensive stance. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +2 bonus to your Armor Class against melee attacks.

features.name: Hooves
features.desc: If you hit a target with an Unarmed Strike, you can deal bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 plus your Strength modifier.

features.name: Born to Navigate
features.desc: You have proficiency in the Perception or Survival skill.

features.name: Darkvision
features.desc: Thanks to your psionic abilities, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray. This trait replaces any Darkvision trait (or similar trait) gained from your original race.

features.name: Disease Inoculation
features.desc: You are immune to disease.

features.name: Limited Psionics
features.desc: You know the message cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the detect thoughts spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells, and when you cast them with this trait they don't require any components.

features.name: Proficiencies
features.desc: You retain the same proficiencies gained from your original race.

features.name: Psionic Resilience
features.desc: You have resistance to psychic damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or possessed.

features.name: Variant: Origin Trait
features.desc: With your GM's permission, you can retain one trait from your original race and/or subrace in place of the Psionic Resilience trait. This trait cannot grant you a feat. This is especially useful for characters whose original race includes a trait that's inextricably linked to them.
